register.reg_long_name: Hypervisor Debug Fine-Grained Write Trap Register 2
register.reg_condition: when FEAT_FGT2 is implemented and FEAT_AA64 is implemented

purpose_text.para: Provides controls for traps of MSR and MCR writes of debug, trace, PMU, and Statistical Profiling System registers.

configuration_text.para: If EL2 is not implemented, this register is RES0 from EL3.

field_description.para: Reserved, RES0.
Trap MSR writes of PMBMAR_EL1 at EL1 using AArch64 to EL2.
This field is ignored by the PE and treated as zero when all of the following are true:

field_value_description.para: If EL2 is implemented and enabled in the current Security state, then MSR writes of PMBMAR_EL1 at EL1 using AArch64 are trapped to EL2 and reported with EC syndrome value 0x18, unless the write generates a higher priority exception.
MSR writes of PMBMAR_EL1 are not trapped by this mechanism.

field_reset_condition.condition: the highest implemented Exception level is EL2
